title: 72 Hours
plot_overview: A 40-year-old advertising executive hoping to save his career is mistakenly added to a group chat and joins a crew of much younger people for a wild Miami bachelor party. As their chaotic weekend unfolds, the age gap brings clashing attitudes and plenty of misadventures.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like fast-moving, chaotic comedies and childish gross-out humor; Not for you if you prefer subtle jokes, fresh ideas, or more developed relationships.
review_summary: Pros: energetic performances; occasional laughs; lively pace | Cons: childish gross-out humor; predictable themes; jokes feel exhausting
